product.name: Personalized Exercise Programs
product.description: Custom exercise plans designed for adults over 65 to improve strength, balance, and flexibility based on individual health, mobility, and goals.

product.name: Live and On-Demand Fitness Classes
product.description: A digital library of live and recorded exercise classes for older adults, covering various fitness types and levels, accessible anytime online.

product.name: Clinical Assessments
product.description: Guided evaluations of mobility, balance, and strength to benchmark progress and tailor exercise programs for older adults.

product.name: Balance and Fall Prevention Programs
product.description: Exercise programs focused on improving balance and reducing fall risk among older adults through targeted training.

product.name: Pain Management Exercise Programs
product.description: Exercise routines aimed at reducing joint pain and improving physical function for older adults with conditions like arthritis.
